sloka: ततः तु आश्रमम् आसाद्य मुनेर् दर्शन कान्क्षिणौ ।सीतया अनुगतौ वीरौ दूरात् एव अवतस्थतुः ॥२-५४-१०॥
transliteration: tataḥ tu āśramam āsādya muner darśana kānkṣiṇau ।sītayā anugatau vīrau dūrāt eva avatasthatuḥ ॥2-54-10॥

translations.english: Thereafter the two heroes followed by Sita arrived at the hermitage and, wishing to see the sage, waited at a distance.
